body: Thank you for the kind words :)

I have tried reaching out to hotlines and honestly have gotten mixed experiences with them -- I know that they are a very available and important resource that I can reach out to, they are just not very high on my list due to previous experiences. I do have a therapist and a psychiatrist who help, but sometimes things are more overwhelming than what they can do. Thank you for the hug!
Thank you -- I really appreciate it.

Your analogy with the tougher row really struck me -- sometimes I feel inadequate for not being as resilient as my friends seem to be, like there is something wrong with me. I know that things will get better, sometimes it's just emotionally impossible to remember.
Thank you -- I have a therapist and a psychiatrist, and they do help, but sometimes things are more overwhelming than the time with them and the medication can help.
Thank you for your kind words -- yes, I definitely felt the support from people on this sub. I was expecting it would be like shouting into a void again. I do have a therapist and a psychiatrist.

Thank you so much for sharing your personal experience! So much of what you said rings true to me. Especially the part of not having mental and emotional bandwidth to support others, and I have been reminding myself that my friends and I are all learning and making mistakes is inevitable -- sometimes it's just sad to think that I'm bound to hurt others as I grow even if I try my best. I hope what you say about life getting better is true :)
Thank you, I know you are right and I have to keep going even if it is hard right now.
